sources.title: Codelco copper mine blockade adds to supply concerns
evidence: Workers at Codelco’s Ministro Hales copper mine in northern Chile blocked access
Union leaders and employees erected barricades and occupied the main entrances
Muñoz said union leaders began occupying the division’s gates at 6 a.m.
He warned that protests could spread to Codelco’s Chuquicamata, Radomiro Tomic and Gabriela Mistral operations

sources.title: Exclusive-US, Canada working on deal to ease steel, auto tariffs, sources say
evidence: The United States and Canada are working on a deal to ease US tariffs on Canadian steel and autos
including up to 50% tariff on Canadian steel and a 25% tariff on autos
a deal on steel and auto tariffs was possible before the November 3 elections
US and Canadian trade talks collapsed in August over issues such as whether to cut duties

sources.title: OPEC+ oil producers set to keep output targets steady at Sunday meeting, sources say
evidence: OPEC+ oil-producing countries are likely to keep their oil production targets steady for December
as the producer group turns its focus to 2027 quota negotiations.
All three people declined to be named and said no final decision had been made.
